current_claim_state.note: Current numerical/context consistency only; neither retained nor confirmed means drawing truth.

height_coverage.note: Coverage means a current adopted z binding, not proof that the drawing or BIM is correct. Inference and declared values do not count as located-image height evidence.

located_height_coverage.note: No height error is asserted. Each height needs its own source-region coverage in an explicitly calibrated elevation. Whole-image citations and absent calibration remain unverified; a shared height on different widths deserves a local check. Report only.

facade_counts.note: Compare observer-reported whole-floor/facade totals with actual source openings. Uncounted facades, zero totals, conflicting evidence and unresolved scopes stay explicit. Equal counts do not prove position or drawing fidelity. Report only.

floor_completeness.note: Floor coverage only; rooms, openings and drawing fidelity are not certified. Unspecified floor scope remains unknown.
